info.title: WMS desktop core command API
info.description: Hợp đồng thiết kế lõi, chưa là API server đã triển khai. CRUD danh mục theo conventions trong README.

get.description: Only APPROVED or PARTIAL purchase orders with positive remaining quantity that the caller may read under document.read: assigned warehouse plus own/assigned document for RECEIVER. Return only the minimal fields in ReceivablePurchaseOrder. Remaining is derived from net posted receipts, not drafts. Cursor is tied to a server-maintained as_of snapshot and immutable (created_at,id) order so intervening edits cannot duplicate or skip rows.

200.description: Receivable purchase orders

get.summary: UC06 get purchase order remaining quantities
get.description: Require document.read on this PO, including own/assigned document for RECEIVER and assigned warehouse. Return current net posted remaining per source line; recheck under lock when posting.

200.description: Purchase order

get.description: Only visible receipts in assigned warehouse scope. Cursor is tied to a server-maintained as_of snapshot and immutable (created_at,id) order so intervening edits cannot duplicate or skip rows.

200.description: Receipt page

post.description: Server assigns id, number, line ids, factor snapshots and version=1. All source_line_id values must belong to one visible APPROVED or PARTIAL PO with positive remaining quantity for the same warehouse and product. Server derives partner_id from that PO; client cannot override it. No stock or PO remaining changes in DRAFT. Persist Idempotency-Key with payload hash atomically; same key and payload replays the same result.

200.description: Receipt

patch.description: Only DRAFT/REJECTED in caller scope. If lines is supplied it replaces all lines and server assigns new line ids; client must GET again before post. expected_version protects concurrent edits. No status, balance or ledger mutation. Use revise before editing an APPROVED receipt.

200.description: Updated draft or replayed result

post.summary: UC06 reopen approved receipt for revision
post.description: Only APPROVED and never posted. In one transaction invalidate approval, release related reservations, change status to DRAFT and increment document version. A later submit and approval are required before post. Idempotency-Key replays the stored result for the same payload.

200.description: Reopened DRAFT or replayed result

post.description: Only APPROVED or PARTIAL receipt in caller scope. In one transaction recheck PO remaining and each receipt line remaining, document version, source line, UOM, lot/serial, destination RECEIVING/QUARANTINE, period and count lock. Cumulative net posted quantity per receipt line must not exceed its base_quantity, including this command. For tracking NONE the server resolves the product stock_item; for LOT/SERIAL it resolves or creates the code under lock and rejects an existing serial position. For a new lot of a product with expiry_required=true, expires_on is mandatory (422 LOT_EXPIRY_REQUIRED); if the lot already exists, supplied dates must match stored metadata (409 LOT_METADATA_CONFLICT). manufactured_on must not be after expires_on. Replay with the same Idempotency-Key and payload returns the stored result. The transaction updates stock and PO progress exactly once.

get.description: Historical proposal, superseded for implemented reads by openapi_runtime.json; see 01_Tai_lieu/TRACEABILITY.md. Design-only response for Q02/T27: physical_base = owned_base + sum(consigned_by_owner.quantity_base) for the same stock item and location. Deny by default until BE02/TL04 defines the ownership dimension and BE04 defines the owner-scoped read permission. stock.read alone does not grant visibility of other owners. Do not infer ownership from stock_item, notes or JSONB.

200.description: Ownership-aware balance (proposal, unavailable until model and permission are approved)

get.summary: UC33 proposed serial receipt and warranty lookup
get.description: Historical proposal, superseded for implemented reads by openapi_runtime.json; see 01_Tai_lieu/TRACEABILITY.md. Design-only read for Q02/T28. Resolve posted receipt, supplier and receipt date for a visible serial. Status is UNKNOWN if the authoritative warranty start, end or evidence is missing; never invent a duration from receipt date. Deny by default until BE02/TL04 defines storage/source and BE04 defines warehouse/serial/price visibility. Repair and RMA are out of scope.

200.description: Serial trace and warranty status, including UNKNOWN when evidence is absent

get.description: Read the immutable committed-operation projection by the original Idempotency-Key. operation_status=COMMITTED describes the command, while status is the resource state. id/status/version are copied from the committed command result; request_id is the original command's stored request ID, not this GET's trace ID. transaction_id is present for posting. A 200 proves commit; 404 is inconclusive. To recover the exact original HTTP status/body, replay the same method, route, body and Idempotency-Key (also the same execution_key for posting). Recheck current resource permission before returning data. Current GET /receipts/{id} may show later state and is not an exact replay.

200.description: Immutable summary of a committed command; original response is obtained by same-key replay

createReceipt.summary: Draft creation after a lost 201 response

patchReceipt.summary: Draft edit after a lost 200 response

postReceipt.summary: Receipt posting after a lost 200 response

404.description: No visible committed result; request may still have executed

example.message: No committed result is currently visible for this key.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per actor and command; never reuse with a different payload.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding response; do not construct or alter it.

AsOf.name: as_of
AsOf.description: Optional on first page; use returned as_of for subsequent pages. UTC offset required.

NotFound.description: Missing resource or outside caller scope

InvalidInput.description: Invalid field, UOM, tracking or quantity

example.message: Quantity must be positive and exact in base UOM.

field_errors.message: Use a positive decimal string with at most 6 places.

PositiveQuantity.description: Positive numeric(20,6) decimal string; never JSON number. Server checks UOM precision and exact base conversion.

source_line_id.description: Line of an APPROVED or PARTIAL PO in the receipt warehouse with positive remaining quantity.

warranty_evidence_ref.description: Evidence identifier or URI; storage mapping pending BE02/TL04.

stock_item_id.description: Existing item identity. Omit for a new lot/serial or tracking NONE.

lot_code.description: For a new or existing LOT item; server resolves or creates lot and stock_item under lock. A new lot of a product with expiry_required=true also needs expires_on.

manufactured_on.description: Optional LOT manufacturing date. If lot exists, supplied value must match stored metadata.

expires_on.description: Required by server for a new LOT when product.expiry_required=true; optional otherwise. Existing lot metadata is immutable through this command.

serial_code.description: For a new or existing SERIAL item; server resolves or creates serial and stock_item under lock.

destination_location_id.description: Must be RECEIVING or QUARANTINE in the receipt warehouse.

quantity_base.description: Decimal chuỗi >0, server kiểm tra độ chính xác UOM; SERIAL=1.

version.description: Có với document/count, bỏ trống với import job.

OperationLookupResult.description: Immutable projection of a committed command; status is resource state, not operation state.
